name: Edvard Munch
findings: Within his own canvases, madder brown turns up as a small accent in 67% of the paintings that hold it, 2.2x the archive's rate (from 1540 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, kobe turns up as the shadow in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 3.1x the archive's rate (from 1540 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1540 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1540 paintings here).
Pairs black brown with dark chocolate brown more than chance would predict (4 of 1540 paintings here).
Pairs pale aqua with pastel blue more than chance would predict (3 of 1540 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (oatmeal, dark jungle green, linen grey) covers 60% of his paintings here.
Keeps 3 distinct palette families here, from oatmeal, dark jungle green to light ivory, oatmeal.
